The '''Massiff Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It shared its name with the reptilian [[Massiff/Legends|massiffs]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].
